question: In which of the following phenomena is solid state directly transformed into gaseous state without changing into liquid state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sublimation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Sublimation** is the process where a substance changes directly from the solid phase to the gaseous phase without passing through the liquid phase.
 
• This phenomenon occurs when the molecules of a solid gain enough energy to transition into the gas phase directly.
